title: Launch conduct playbook: channel heatmap, owner RACI, and webinar/timing runbook
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Create a single-source-of-truth operational playbook for announcing the Adaptive Routing feature across channels (blog, email, social, webinar, docs) that includes a channel heatmap, explicit owner RACI, embargo windows, content templates for release notes snippets, and a tactical timeline tied to rollout gates. This ticket coordinates PM -> Eng -> Design -> Comms -> Growth tasks required for a low-friction, measurable launch.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a public-ready launch playbook doc with channel-by-channel schedule and templates
Assign channel owners and reviewers (RACI) and confirm availability across launch window
Embed release-notes snippets in product repo and Docs PR with agreed wording and compatibility notes
Schedule webinar (date/time) and confirm host, panelists, registration page, and replay workflow
Confirm monitoring dashboard and SLAs to track rollout and customer impact post-launch
tasks: Draft announcement timeline (T-minus 14d, 7d, 2d, publish, post-publish cadence)
Create channel heatmap mapping message variants to personas and locales
Produce release-notes snippet (short + long) and FAQ for docs team
Design hero blog assets and a summary GIF showing routing failover behavior
Prepare email templates (beta users, paid customers, public announce) and test subject lines
Book webinar: confirm host (PM), engineering demo lead, and GC for Q&A; create registration form
Create social copy matrix with suggested cadence and hashtags for LinkedIn, X, and Mastodon
Open Docs PR with migration notes and enablement guide for Solutions Engineers
Create support runbook: triage steps, rollback options, and escalation contacts
Set up dashboard widgets: blog views, email CTRs, API error rate, average latency, and capacity usage
channel_heatmap: Blog: long-form technical summary + demo GIF, target audience: engineers and platform leads; publish at 09:00 PT on launch day
Email (public): 1-paragraph TL;DR + link to blog and webinar; send noon PT on launch day
Email (customers): targeted notes about contract/perf benefits, include migration guide link; send T-minus 2 days
Webinar: live demo and Q&A; scheduled T-plus 2 days; record and add to docs
Social: 3 posts first week (announce, highlight telemetry, webinar reminder); platform-specific variants
Docs: how-to, release notes, and migration guide available at GA time
Sales enablement: internal play deck + one-pager for AE teams distributed T-minus 3 days
owner_raci: Product (Sofia Ramirez) - Accountable for messaging and timeline
Engineering (Leah Kim) - Responsible for demo readiness and rollout gating
Design (Omar Williams) - Responsible for hero assets and GIFs
Marketing (Priya Desai) - Responsible for blog and social copy
Growth (Evan Cole) - Responsible for email templates and segmentation
Docs (Anita Bose) - Responsible for docs PR and release notes
Support (Marcus Lee) - Responsible for runbook and on-call staffing
Sales Eng (Nina Park) - Consulted for enablement materials
risk_mitigation: If demo fails during webinar: have recorded demo + backup engineer available; notify comms channel
If latency regressions observed after rollout: automatically throttle adaptive routing and trigger rollback policy
If external embargo is broken: move blog to immediate publish and coordinate follow-up comms
If docs PR not merged by GA: publish a minimal release-note snippet and mark docs as 'coming shortly'
metrics_kpis: Email open rate and CTR (customers vs public)
Feature adoption: percent of traffic routed via Adaptive Routing at +1 week
API error rate and P95 latency post-launch
Support volume: number of tickets labeled 'Adaptive Routing' first 72 hours
rollout_steps: Canary to 5% with telemetry gates for 60m
If stable, advance to 25% with monitoring for 3h
Advance to 100% when latency and error KPIs within thresholds for 24h
If any gate trips, execute rollback plan and notify stakeholders via #launch-alerts channel
webinar_details: Recording: post-event upload to Docs and YouTube; add timestamps and transcript
